rows.label: qst630407_msg0002
rows.name:
I hope that eases some of his
regret...

rows.label: qst630407_msg0003
rows.name: He had a daughter named Ondina.

rows.label: qst630407_msg0004
rows.name:
She might be getting married soon, so
he kept saying he absolutely had to
make it home alive, but...

rows.label: qst630407_msg0005
rows.name:
Things never seem to work out when
someone says that...

rows.label: qst630407_msg0006
rows.name:
He had survived harsh battlefields for
decades...

rows.label: qst630407_msg0008
rows.name:
The mission was canceled, but I have a
duty to tell Ondina.

rows.label: qst630407_msg0009
rows.name:
If you happen to see Ondina, could you
keep this from her?
